basic_details.post_name: Police Constable, Head Constable Driver Mechanic Grade-2, Motor Transport Supervisor Grade-2
basic_details.short_information: Gujarat Police Recruitment Board (GPRB) has released the Gujarat Police Bharti 2026 notification for 3,000 Class-3 vacancies in the Gujarat Police Force. The recruitment includes 2,841 Lokrakshak (Police Constable) posts, 133 Head Constable Driver Mechanic Grade-2 posts and 26 Motor Transport Supervisor Grade-2 posts. The official newspaper advertisement was issued on 19 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Candidates should verify the official application fee for their category and selected post before completing the application process.

qualification.education_qualification: Class 12 or equivalent; additional technical qualifications for Motor Transport posts
qualification.details: For the Lokrakshak cadre, candidates must have passed the Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSC) Examination from the Secondary and Higher Secondary Education Board or possess an equivalent qualification recognised by the Government. | This qualification applies to the Unarmed Police Constable, Armed Police Constable and Armed Police Constable (SRPF) posts advertised under GPRB/202627/1. | Candidates applying for the Head Constable Driver Mechanic Grade-2 post must satisfy both the general educational qualification and the prescribed technical training requirement. | Passed the Higher Secondary School Certificate (Class 12) examination or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Government. Possess a Motor Mechanic Vehicle Trade Certificate along with one year of apprenticeship from a government-recognised industrial institute; or Possess a three-year apprenticeship certificate in the Motor Mechanic Vehicle Trade under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme. | For the Motor Transport Supervisor Grade-2 post, candidates must meet the following educational and technical requirements: | Passed the Higher Secondary School Certificate (Class 12) examination or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Government. Possess a Motor Mechanic Vehicle Trade Certificate along with one year of apprenticeship from a government-recognised Industrial Training Institute (ITI); or Possess a three-year apprenticeship certificate in the Motor Mechanic Vehicle Trade under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme.

how_to_apply: Candidates can apply online for Gujarat Police Bharti 2026 through the official OJAS Gujarat portal from 26 November 2026 at 2:00 PM to 16 December 2026 at 11:59 PM.
Visit the official OJAS Gujarat website at https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in/.
Open the recruitment advertisements or online application section.
Select the applicable recruitment advertisement: GPRB/202627/1, GPRB/202627/2 or GPRB/202627/3.
Read the detailed notification and check the prescribed eligibility criteria.
Open the relevant online application form and enter the required details accurately.
Upload the necessary documents, photograph and signature in the format specified by the portal, wherever required.
Complete the required application and fee payment steps, if applicable, following the official instructions.
Confirm the completed online application using the CONFIRM option.
Download or print the confirmed application form and retain it for future reference.

Important: The Gujarat Police Recruitment Board has instructed candidates to submit separate online applications for the Lokrakshak, Head Constable Driver Mechanic Grade-2 and Motor Transport Supervisor Grade-2 recruitment categories, wherever they wish to apply and meet the eligibility requirements.
Candidates must confirm their online application and preserve a printed copy, which must be produced if requested by the recruitment board.
Applications submitted by post, email or in person will not be accepted.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Bharti 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: Gujarat Police Recruitment Board has announced the application schedule for all three advertised recruitment categories. Candidates can submit their online applications through the OJAS Gujarat portal during the prescribed application period.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Bharti 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The Gujarat Police Recruitment Board has announced 3,000 vacancies in the Lokrakshak and Motor Transport Technical cadres. The Lokrakshak cadre accounts for 2,841 posts, while the remaining 159 vacancies belong to the technical cadre.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Constable Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The board has stated that the Lokrakshak vacancy count may be revised if the Gujarat Government approves additional posts.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Bharti 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: The detailed recruitment instructions are scheduled to be uploaded to the OJAS Gujarat website on 26 November 2026. Candidates must read the instructions carefully before applying. GPRB/202627/1 - Lokrakshak Cadre: 2,841 vacancies GPRB/202627/2 - Head Constable Driver Mechanic Grade-2: 133 vacancies GPRB/202627/3 - Motor Transport Supervisor Grade-2: 26 vacancies Applicants should check the official Gujarat Police Recruitment Board website for recruitment notices, corrigenda and further announcements. Gujarat Police Newspaper Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: For the Lokrakshak cadre, candidates must have passed the Higher Secondary School Certificate (HSC) Examination from the Secondary and Higher Secondary Education Board or possess an equivalent qualification recognised by the Government. This qualification applies to the Unarmed Police Constable, Armed Police Constable and Armed Police Constable (SRPF) posts advertised under GPRB/202627/1. Candidates applying for the Head Constable Driver Mechanic Grade-2 post must satisfy both the general educational qualification and the prescribed technical training requirement. Passed the Higher Secondary School Certificate (Class 12) examination or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Government. Possess a Motor Mechanic Vehicle Trade Certificate along with one year of apprenticeship from a government-recognised industrial institute; or Possess a three-year apprenticeship certificate in the Motor Mechanic Vehicle Trade under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme. For the Motor Transport Supervisor Grade-2 post, candidates must meet the following educational and technical requirements: Passed the Higher Secondary School Certificate (Class 12) examination or an equivalent qualification recognised by the Government. Possess a Motor Mechanic Vehicle Trade Certificate along with one year of apprenticeship from a government-recognised Industrial Training Institute (ITI); or Possess a three-year apprenticeship certificate in the Motor Mechanic Vehicle Trade under the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat Police Bharti 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates should verify the official application fee for their category and selected post before completing the application process.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Gujarat Police Bharti 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates can apply online for Gujarat Police Bharti 2026 through the official OJAS Gujarat portal from 26 November 2026 at 2:00 PM to 16 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. Important: The Gujarat Police Recruitment Board has instructed candidates to submit separate online applications for the Lokrakshak, Head Constable Driver Mechanic Grade-2 and Motor Transport Supervisor Grade-2 recruitment categories, wherever they wish to apply and meet the eligibility requirements. Candidates must confirm their online application and preserve a printed copy, which must be produced if requested by the recruitment board. Applications submitted by post, email or in person will not be accepted.

content_sections.text: The online application window for Gujarat Police Bharti 2026 will open on 26 November 2026 at 2:00 PM. The deadline to submit the application is 16 December 2026 at 11:59 PM. faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for GPRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment process is managed and conducted by the Gujarat Police Recruitment Board (GPRB) for various Class-3 police and technical cadre posts.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are announced in GPRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 3000 vacancies have been announced across multiple positions including Unarmed Police Constable, Armed Police Constable, Head Constable Driver Mechanic, and Motor Transport Supervisor.

faq.question: Q3. When does the online application process start for GPRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application process begins on 26 November 2026 via the OJAS portal for eligible candidates seeking government employment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit online applications for GPRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications through the official portal is 16 December 2026 until 23:59 hours.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum educational qualification required for GPRB Constable posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the Higher Secondary School Certificate Examination (12th standard) from a recognized board to apply for the Lokrakshak cadre posts.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are needed for technical posts like Head Constable Driver Mechanic?
faq.answer: Applicants must possess a 12th pass qualification along with a Motor Mechanic Vehicle Trade Certificate and relevant apprenticeship from an ITI or under NATS.

faq.question: Q7. Through which portal should candidates submit their applications?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to submit their online applications exclusively through the official OJAS Gujarat website at https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required for GPRB Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any application fee details for submitting the online forms for these advertised positions.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should be kept after submitting the online application?
faq.answer: Candidates must print and keep a copy of their confirmed online application form safely for personal records and submission when demanded by the board.

faq.question: Q10. Where can candidates check the detailed official notification for GPRB Recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can access the detailed official advertisement and updates directly on the official Gujarat Police Recruitment Board website.
